title: Create LeaderboardMiniSection dashboard component
description: Create mini leaderboard widget for dashboard. Shows top 5 users with toggle between Streak/Progress. Shows user's own rank. 'Set name to join' CTA if no displayName. Link to full leaderboard.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shows top 5 users for selected leaderboard type
Toggle between Streak and Progress tabs
Shows medals for top 3 (gold, silver, bronze)
Shows current user's rank highlighted if in top 50
Shows 'Set display name to join' if user has no displayName
